plan.title: Asked why she missed, ZOH answers from her texts; asked something not on record, it says it doesn't know

context.text: Hey Maya, how'd tonight's 10 pages go?
ugh work ran till 10, I'm wiped. didn't get to it
Long day, I hear you. Rest up, and tomorrow night we're back on page 212 📚

transcript.text: Yanni: why did she miss yesterday?

Maya said work ran until 10 pm and she was wiped, so she didn't get to her 10 pages. That's from her text at 10:57 PM Sunday. She had done all 7 days before that. I told her we'd pick it back up tonight on page 212. She hasn't said anything else about it.
Yanni: has her sister's visit been getting in the way?

I don't know. Nothing in her texts or my notes mentions a sister or a visit. The only reason she gave for yesterday was work running late. If a visit is happening, I can save a note so I coach around it. Or I can ask her about it.
